title: 'I'm trying to build a company that's Incorruptible as Eric Ries would say and that means protecting my mission at all costs' — a founder off-boards a client who begged to stay
summary: Founder and CEO Paige Kaye describes off-boarding a childcare-services client who pleaded to remain — framing the decision as protecting her mission against the pull of easy revenue, and citing Incorruptible as the language for the choice.
blockquote: I'm trying to build a company that's Incorruptible as Eric Ries would say and that means protecting my mission at all costs.
